title: chat-vtc-server: SpaceBan ejection (eject_banned_user)
description: Split from JMAP-8mem.6. vtc L1587 (draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00 at jmap-chat-spec 0cd3af0): 'When a user is banned from a Space (via SpaceBan creation) and has an active VTCParticipant record in a call bound to that Space (via spaceId), the server MUST set leftAt on that VTCParticipant record and emit a VTCParticipantEvent with event "left".' Add to crate-jmap-chat-vtc-server: pub async fn eject_banned_user<V: VtcBackend>(vtc, caller, account_id, space_id, user_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<VtcParticipantEvent>, BackendSetError<V::Error>>: calls with spaceId == space_id and state != ended; participants in them with userId == user_id, joinedAt set, leftAt null; patch leftAt = now via VtcBackend::update_object::<VtcParticipant>; return one 'left' event each (deliver is the caller's job). The consumer's ChatBackend::on_space_ban_created calls contact_identity(ban.userId) (already landed) then this. Blocked because VtcParticipant has no SetObject impl at HEAD (only JmapObject); the impl was uncommitted work in the tree on 2026-10-20. Test: seed active, ringing (joinedAt null) and other-Space participants for the banned identity plus another user; assert only the active in-Space record gets leftAt and exactly one hand-written 'left' event. Update README/AGENTS.md crate map/CHANGELOG.
notes:
Mark 2026-10-20: VTC specs have known bugs; no further VTC crate work until the spec is fixed.
Mark 2026-10-20: Scene/VTC specs fixed (jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08); work resumed. Re-check scope against new spec before implementing.
